# PR 268 reviewer verdict

Head: 6e28e49d670df0b5a9469250eabd115cea53fad2
Result: PASS. No correctness findings.

The four-file documentation change correctly separates inherited launch environment from process ownership. `docs/how/daemon-cost.md:54-56` anchors attribution to the registered pid plus start time and explicitly says to prune every `__omp_worker_*` process AND its subtree from a seat's accounting, even when it descends from that seat.

This is consistent with the relevant implementations:

- `crates/tmux/src/lib.rs:1605-1633,1656-1730` selects the nearest unique matching harness from the pane snapshot, revalidates the selected start time, and retains the complete subtree as separate evidence. It does not assign ownership by environment or charge all subtree members to the selected seat. The existing captured-interpreter fixture at `:1969-1988` explicitly rejects the bun.exe worker command.
- `harness/scripts/spawn-rate.py:102-112,141-150` classifies launches by immediate parent into daemon/status-line/other. It is not a per-seat environmental survey and does not claim to implement the new worker-subtree reporting rule.
- The Copilot-only smoke helper at `harness/scripts/copilot-native-memory-smoke.ts:657-705` selects owned descendants before examining its extension marker; it is not an environment-based OMP seat-attribution path.

The homes are appropriate: canonical measurement instructions in daemon-cost, a short reminder in the PA's cost/size-reporting brief (`skills/pij/references/prime/pa.md:124-128`), and the performance-review checklist in `AGENTS.md:107`. The exception is explicit in the canonical page and AGENTS, with the PA reminder linking back to the full rule.

`docs/difficulties.md:179-180` closes D-F203-1 without implying a product-code fix. D-F223-1 remains a clearly labeled stretch; possible worker death on pane kill is explicitly not observed and depends on detachment. No new loop, hook, poll, timer, launch, or runtime cost: rate 0, no per-seat scaling.

Validation: `just pr-freeze 268` PASS/FINAL at this exact head; `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` PASS; worktree clean. GitHub CI run 44493010700 attempt 1 is SUCCESS at this SHA, and all five PR checks passed. No builds, installs, local test runners, live process-environment reads, or product edits were performed; documentation-only changes need no behavioral test run.

Harness feedback: observation reviewer-268/MW-001 records one future encoding opportunity: if a seat-cost survey is added later, give its pure classifier an explicit fixture where a machine-wide worker subtree descends from a seat but is accounted separately. Not a requested change or merge condition for this docs PR.
